adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the new implementation always executes `total = group.users.count` and then separately fetches the paged `members` (`order...limit...offset`), which is an extra query on every request (diff shows this was introduced). Whether the caller “can’t use” the metadata is not supported by the diff (the JSON response now always includes `meta.total`, and the JS `findMembers()` consumes it), but the core performance concern about an unconditional count query is real and diff-grounded.
